subject: Re: Kickoff: microscope focus-quality QC — June status + montage memory risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: Focus_check montages are running end-to-end on the first partner's plates — whole-plate, per-channel, and QC review time per plate dropped from ~45 min of site-by-site clicking to under 5. Katya's macro consolidation is on track; the master script with on/off flags (including single-site analysis) is in review.

Risk worth naming: the second partner's plates are 4 channels at 16-bit with 3x our assumed site count. Whole-plate montage assembly for those peaks at ~38 GB RAM and falls over on the standard lab workstations. Options: (a) tiled assembly with downsampled previews, ~2 weeks of my time; (b) tell partner 2 to run it server-side, which weakens the "runs in Fiji at the bench" story.

I lean (a) but it pushes the leaderboard-integration work Jorge needs from me into July. Flagging the trade-off before I commit.

Halima
